author: Cptnwhizbang
body:
Focus on survivability fully. Even though it's slower, consider using Charmer and not Benefactor to give yourself the appease buff. Use Buggane for damage and let them carry you. If you can get your summoner protection chance up, and your ward,nyoy should be in good shape. Appease will only help protect you more and more.


Another tip is to stick as benefactor and spam stun dart 24/7 on the tower bosses. The raids aren't immune to stun and it basically locks down tower fall outside of bad RNG. Spam stun dart all day and ride your way to success

author: IamMisterT
body:
I’d say just take the shards and go. At T9 a stray towerfall will usually end the run. You don’t really need the adornments until you have the required weapons. 

Else just clear the event tower for adornments since those towers are easier. You can skip the Titan on 2F.

body: I maximized health and ward for my gear. I had like 8k health and 32k ward. Utilize stun and other spells like miasma to reduce the chance the titan can do anything during their turn.
